text.body:
॥ ardhanārīśvarastotram ॥
cāmpeyagaurārdhaśarīrakāyai karpūragaurārdhaśarīrakāya । dhammillakāyaica jaṭādharāya namaḥ śivāyai ca namaḥ śivāya ॥1 kastūrikākuṅkumacarcitāyai citārajāpuñjavicarcitāya । kṛtasmarāyai vikṛtasmarāya namaḥ ...॥2 jhaṇatkvaṇatkaṅkaṇanūpurāyai pādābjarājasphaṇinūpurāya । hemāṅgadāyai bhujagāṅgadāya namaḥ ...॥ 3 viśālanīlotpalalocanāyai vikāsipaṅkerulocanāya । samekṣaṇāyai viṣamekṣaṇāya namaḥ ...॥ 4 mandāramālākalitālakāya kapālamālāṅkitakandharāya । divyāmbarāyai ca digambarāya namaḥ ...॥ 5
ambhodharaśyāmalakuntalāyai taṭitprabhātābhrajaṭādharāya । nirīśvarāyai nikhileśvarāya namaḥ ...॥ 6 prapañcasṛṣṭyunmukhalāsyakāyai samastasaṃhārakatāṇḍavāya । jagajananyai jagadekapitre namaḥ ... ॥7 pradīptaratnojjvalakuṇḍalāyai sphuranmahāpannagabhūṣaṇāya । śivānvitāyai ca śivānvitāya namaḥ ...॥8 etatpaṭhedaṣṭakamiṣṭadaṃ yo bhaktyā sa mānyo bhuvi dīrghajīvī। prāpnoti saubhāgyamanantakālaṃ bhūyātsadā tasya samastasiddhiḥ ॥ 9
॥ iti śrīmacchaṅkarācāryaviracitaṃ ardhanārīśvarastotraṃ sampūrṇam ॥
